title: DRC/ERC report 'unverifiable' instead of false-clean
summary: When the kernel can't parse a board or schematic (e.g. a malformed layer name like 'In1.Cu'), run_drc, run_erc, and critique_route now return an errored 'unverifiable' result with the offending field — instead of a dangerous '0 violations / clean' a user could ship on.
